items.title: Global Payments (GPN) Cuts Annual Forecasts As Middle East Conflict Hits Travel Spending
items.summary: Global Payments cut its annual net revenue and profit forecasts after travel spending was disrupted by ongoing conflict in the Middle East. The payments company cited weaker volumes in travel related transactions as a key driver of the revised outlook. This move highlights how geopolitical events can affect cross border payment flows and consumer spending. For investors watching NYSE:GPN, the forecast cut comes with the stock trading at $88.25.
